correctness.rationale: For unordered multiset codewords x,y, a common size-three deletion output exists iff I(x,y)=Σmin(x_i,y_i)>=3. Distinct heavy codewords x_i>=3 inject into q symbol coordinates. For two light vectors, I>=2n−2q>=4 when n>=q+2, so at most one light. No light exists for n>2q; q pure vectors attain q and adding a light vector attains q+1 up to 2q. Two light witnesses give q+2 at n=q+1, including both parities; independently checked constructions q=2..6. The mathematical formula is sound.
